root_cause: Instagram Mira winner selection could still freeze a calendar seed without proving that the topic came from current public human-friction evidence. A generic Instagram research corpus also did not prove the chosen daily story source.
prevention: Use one dedicated canonical public human-problem signal store and lineage.
Reject support/contact/FAQ pages as complaint evidence unless explicit public complaint language is present.
Require source_signal_id and source_lineage before daily winner selection.
Block exact source/hash reuse for 90 days and nearby same-topic repetition while allowing materially new stories.
Write provider publication, metrics and social-learning evaluation back to the same lineage row.
